title: Spicy Korean Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry dish inspired by Korean cuisine, made with a variety of vegetables and a kick of heat.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add onion and bell peppers; stir-fry until tender.
Add garlic and ginger; stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add stir-fry sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with green onions and toasted sesame seeds (if desired).
